title: Grusch + Bipartisan Congress Members Announce June 9 Capitol Steps UAP Disclosure Demand
detail: A bipartisan coalition of four U.S. Representatives — Eric Burlison (R-MO), Anna Paulina Luna (R-FL), Tim Burchett (R-TN), and Jared Moskowitz (D-FL) — announced on May 28 a joint press conference with whistleblower David Grusch, journalist Leslie Kean, and filmmaker James Fox, scheduled for June 9, 2026 at 1:00 PM on the U.S. Capitol steps. The announcement, issued via PR Newswire, frames the event as a call for three specific actions: (1) immediate release of the classified UAP files Grusch has flagged to congressional oversight bodies; (2) passage of the UAP Disclosure Act; and (3) strengthened whistleblower protections for individuals who come forward with UAP-related information. Grusch's framing: 'President Trump now has a historic opportunity; this press conference is about moving from testimony to action.' The event marks the first time Grusch has publicly appeared alongside this specific configuration of bipartisan lawmakers in a coordinated outside-chamber media setting. Organized against the backdrop of the PURSUE program (226 files across two tranches, Tranche 3 confirmed in production), the June 9 press conference represents the highest-profile UAP disclosure coordination event since the July 2023 House Oversight hearing. Congressional UAP advocates are escalating their strategy to build public pressure ahead of the EO 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026.
